3 ضآءل شَخْصَهُ , (M, TA,) [in the O, and in copies of the K, ضَأَلَ, but the former is the right,] He made his person small, (M, O, * K, TA,) in order that he might not appear. (TA.) Zuheyr says, “فَبَيْنَا نَذُودُ الوَحْشَ جَآءَ غُلَامُنَا
يَدِبُّ وَيُخْفِى شَخْصَهُ وَيُضَائِلُهْ
” [And while we were driving the wild animals, our young man came, creeping, and hiding his person, and making it small]. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
